quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within the following distances of any fire hydrant, whether or not the location is posted with a sign, whether or not the adjacent curb or roadway surface is painted red, and whether the location is on public or private property: (a) At a location where parallel parking is permitted, fifteen feet; (b) At a location where angle parking is permitted or no parking is permitted, twenty feet.

activation.condition: Motor vehicle stops, stands or parks within a source-measured body distance of a hydrant on public or private premises.

obligation.description: Retain fifteen feet where parallel parking is permitted and twenty feet where angle or no parking is permitted; independent permission source selects the branch.
obligation.source_clause: Within the following distances of any fire hydrant

exceptions.source_clause: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.description: Traffic conflict necessity requires original actor motion and independent causal review.
An applicable law and the exact reason for parking require independent source review.

exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
exceptions.description: Original lawful direction and applicability require independent source review.

timing.description: Measure the entire stopped, standing or parked interval and retain frame uncertainty.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original parking permission selects the statutory distance; curb paint alone does not.
